description: This file provides a PHP class implementation for the Oracle 8.0.5 (oci8) driver in the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It defines driver-specific behaviors such as optimized SELECT queries with hints and class extensions for handling database connections and recordsets.

classes.name: ADODB_oci805
classes.description: Driver class for Oracle 8.0.5 (oci8) in ADOdb, extending the base OCI8 driver to include support for FIRST_ROWS hint in queries.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci805
classes.description: Recordset class for oci805 driver, extending the OCI8 recordset class.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Overrides the base method to add an Oracle-specific hint, FIRST_ROWS, to optimize paginated SELECT queries.
